text: Minimum node radius for value-less ideas instead of a size constant
description: Node radius = 150·√(value/avg + 0.02); the constant was lowered from 0.1 so areas stay close to value. Side effect: zero-value ideas have radius 21 (≈15% of average) and are harder to click or drop connections on. A floor on the radius would only affect tiny ideas, while the constant changes every size.
